invoker.name: DataGerry
invoker.description: DATAGERRY is an Open Source CMDB & Asset Management Tool, which completely leaves the definition of a data model to the user.
invoker.hint: This interface uses Basic auth with a DataGerry user (username and password). The REST API has to be enabled by the REST API feature of your DataGerry license. API documentation: https://docs.datagerry.com/en/latest/reference/rest-api.html
